text:
anya: Heads-up: az-east1 NIC firmware harmonization + small kernel patch. We're scheduling a staggered maintenance to reconcile driver/microcode mismatch that has been spiking p99 on long sequences. Window: 2026-05-12 23:30 UTC start, 03:30 UTC end. Expect 6 cohorts.
tom: cohort breakdown? how much capacity per cohort and expected outage behaviour?
anya: cohorts are smaller this time to limit tail impact: 6 cohorts ~8 racks each (~7% region capacity). Each cohort ~18-25m (cordon -> graceful drain -> reboot -> probe -> uncordon). We will avoid killing pods unless graceful timeout hit. No planned full-service outage; some request retries and elevated latencies possible.
sophie: any dedicated pools impacted (private/dedicated customers)?
anya: Dedicated pools with tag `private-east` will be opt-out by default. If autoscaler can't maintain headroom, small temporary placement onto pre-warmed burst nodes in us-west may occur. We'll flag customers via console banner + targeted message and set retention for audit.
devops-bot: Maintenance event created: https://status.redwood/maintenance/az-east1-1812223333 :calendar: (window 23:30-03:30 UTC)
lee-oncall: I'll take oncall for the night window 23:20-03:40 UTC. Escalation thresholds: p95 > 250ms or error-rate increase > 0.7% or request drop > 0.2%. Ping me.
tom: can we pre-seed caches and mirror traffic to warm nodes? I want a smoke job to validate kvcache handshake.
anya: yes. Pre-seed plan: run `smoke-gen` load against cohorts 10-15m before cordon. Commands from ops bastion:
```
# preheat kvcache for cohort 2
ssh ops@bastion
./smoke-gen --region az-east1 --cohort 2 --warmup 900 --qps 120
kvcache-tool seed --region az-east1 --cohort 2 --shards 8 --parallel 6
```
After reboot, run golden probe: `curl -sS https://ops.redwood/health/az-east1/cohort/2 | jq .status` should show "ok" and p95 < 150ms before uncordon.
sophie: what's our rollback? If we see sustained p95 degradation we fail open or keep cordoned?
anya: rollback policy: stop further cohorts, keep the current cohort cordoned and route new traffic to eu-central pre-warmed fallback. If errors persist >5m after failover, escalate to infra lead (tag @infra-lead) and consider reimaging the cohort. Automatic failover to eu-central will kick in after 90s of healthcheck failures for affected tenants.
lee-oncall: add runbook snippet to channel and link to pager duty play. Also let's ensure observability: enable high-resolution tracing (1s) for models running in az-east1 for the window.
devops-bot: Observability toggle applied: tracing=high-res for az-east1 from 23:10-04:00 UTC.
anya: communication checklist: console banner (ops console), status page event, email to top 30 tenants by QPS, and a short note in #customer-success. We'll attach the full playbook after this thread.
tom: quick ask on cost: will rerouting to us-west spike egress billing or on-demand GPU spend?
anya: small spike expected in inter-region egress and burst nodes. Finance estimate ~ $2.5k worst case for full fallback across 6 cohorts. We'll track cost center `infra-maint` and tag charges.
sophie: perfect. I'll prepare the targeted customer list and the email copy.
lee-oncall: I'll standby 10m before the window and run the first cohort with anya.
anya: thanks all. Posting full runbook + checklist in /runbooks/az-east1-nic-harmony.md and the ops pager. See you in the window :rocket:
